info.title: mdfetch
info.description: Small CLI to download any web resource as a markdown (with markitdown-api).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Small CLI to download any web resource as a markdown (with native .NET or markitdown-api).

options.name: --output
options.description: The path of the output markdown file (overrides positional argument if both are specified).

options.name: --engine
options.description: Conversion engine to use: 'native' (default, pure .NET managed) or 'api' (markitdown-api). [default: native]

options.name: --use-api
options.description: Use external markitdown-api instead of native .NET conversion (shortcut for --engine api).

options.name: --api-url
options.description: The markitdown API server URL (automatically selects the API engine). [default: http://127.0.0.1:8490]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for downloading and processing. [default: 30]

options.name: --filter-hidden-text
options.description: Filter hidden text and invisible elements from HTML content (default: true).

options.name: --no-filter-hidden-text
options.description: Disable filtering of hidden text and elements in HTML.

options.name: --detect-prompt-injection
options.description: Detect prompt injection attacks in fetched content (default: true).

options.name: --no-detect-prompt-injection
options.description: Disable prompt injection detection in fetched content.

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description:
The URL of the web resource to fetch.
<output file>  The path of the output markdown file. If not specified, markdown is written to stdout.
